paragraphs.text: Flames lick at your legs. Your eyes water. You are shrouded in smoke. It might be your imagination, but you think you can feel a slight give in the chains. You throw yourself against them, giving no thought to how they bite into your wrists.
Take 1D6 hit points of damage from the fire. If this reduces you to zero, you collapse and are burned to death! The End. Otherwise, make a STR roll. If you succeed, go to 93. If you fail, go to 77.
